title: Isaiah 41:8 — Abraham My friend
summary: Isaiah 41:8 in English and Hebrew: God calls Israel His servant, Jacob His chosen, and Abraham 'My friend'. 'Abraham' is coloured blue in both languages, and 'My friend' (אהבי, ohavi) is underlined in blue and yellow and repeated large at the bottom.

text.text: 8 "But you, Israel, My servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, Descendant of Abraham My friend,
8 ואתה ישראל עבדי יעקב אשר בחרתיך זרע אברהם אהבי׃

words.gloss: My friend (My lover, the one who loves Me)

uncertain: Only part of the Hebrew word אברהם is blue (the letters אבר and the final ם); read as the whole name Abraham being highlighted.
